title: Ordinary compact support under the specified closure transport
statement: Fix D,l,X,Y,f₀ with D a finite-field datum, l prime and different from D.p, X and Y separated finite-type D.k₀-models and f₀ a separated finite-type morphism. Let c₀ be any compactification of f₀.left and c any compactification of geometricMap D f₀. On the full bounded constructible native category over the library algebraic closure, ordinaryCompactSupport f₀.left c₀ followed by the derived pushforward of closureMap Y is naturally isomorphic to derived pushforward of closureMap X followed by actual l c. The conclusion involves only native ordinary functors, with no realization family, coefficient system, Weil action or forgetful model.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence; ordinary comparison, closure transport and scalar realization.

proof.text: The algebraic-closure equivalence makes closureMap X and closureMap Y isomorphisms. Apply pullback.hom_ext and the two geometricFiberMap projection equations to obtain their naturality square with f₀. Geometric base change gives an open i and proper p from c₀. Define d with the same middle scheme, open map inv(closureMap X) followed by i, and proper map p followed by closureMap Y. Their composite is geometricMap f₀ by the naturality square and c₀.comm.

proof.text: For a scheme isomorphism e, the source-transport comparison i_! ≅ e_* followed by (e⁻¹ followed by i)_! follows by conjugating the upper-star composition isomorphism and upperStarIsoLowerStarInv through the open adjunctions and e_* equivalence. Apply mapDerivedCategory. The target-transport comparison is the inverse exact-right total-derived compositor followed by the pushforward composition isomorphism. Compose these to compare the c₀ functor followed by closureMap Y with closureMap X followed by actual d on the entire native derived category.

proof.text: Choose a normalized realization family and a coefficient system S for geometricMap f₀. At c and d use the specified scalar-realization comparison. A common refinement r of c and d supplies (S.refinements.refinement rc .closed).left.symm followed by (S.refinements.refinement rd .closed).left. The realization image clause lifts the bounded source inclusion to the common-stage category, by full faithfulness and Mathlib essential-image lifting. Whisker the two scalar comparisons and this refinement comparison with the lift and cancel its realization isomorphism. Thus actual d and actual c agree on the full bounded constructible subcategory.

proof.text: Closure pushforward is naturally isomorphic to pullback under the inverse closure isomorphism. The bounded-homology pullback theorem preserves both boundedness and constructible cohomology, so this pushforward restricts to the bounded source category. Whisker the preceding d-to-c comparison with that restriction and compose with the c₀-to-d transport. This is the displayed natural isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_closure_compact_support
    (X Y : Space D) (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
    [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (c₀ : Compactification f₀.left) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀)) :
    Nonempty
      ((ProEtale.DerivedCategory.boundedAdicConstructible l
          X.base.hom.geometricFiber).ι ⋙
        NativeWeilOpenProper.ordinaryCompactSupport (k₀ := D.k₀) (l := l) f₀.left c₀ ⋙
          (ProEtale.adicLowerStar l (closureMap D Y)).rightDerivedFunctor ≅
       (ProEtale.DerivedCategory.boundedAdicConstructible l
          X.base.hom.geometricFiber).ι ⋙
        (ProEtale.adicLowerStar l (closureMap D X)).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
          LocallyFiniteAdicCompactSupport.actual l c)
